title: Multidisciplinary and multiagency reviews.
bodyText: The department of health may conduct multidisciplinary and multiagency reviews of maternal deaths to reduce the incidence of preventable maternal deaths.
bodyHtml: [§324-5]  Multidisciplinary and multiagency reviews.  The department of health may conduct multidisciplinary and multiagency reviews of maternal deaths to reduce the incidence of preventable maternal deaths. [L 2016, c 203, pt of §5]
